Visitor preserve_html action includes raw HTML in output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitCustomElement(NodeContext ctx, String tagName, String html) {
                return new VisitResult.PreserveHtml();
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<div><custom-tag>Custom content</custom-tag></div>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
